children: MBody AI’s hardware-agnostic platform was shortlisted alongside CrowdStrike, Lenovo and CVS Health in a category recognizing real-world AI deployment
ISFIYA, Israel and LAS VEGAS, Sept. 02, 2026
-- MBody AI Ltd. ("MBody AI" or the "Company")

today announced that its MBody AI Orchestrator™ platform has been shortlisted for AI Deployment of the Year in The 2026 A.I. Awards. The awards program is run by The Cloud Awards. The category recognizes the most impactful and innovative deployment of artificial intelligence within the past year. MBody AI was shortlisted alongside CrowdStrike, Lenovo, CVS Health and Lloyds Banking Group.

Orchestrator is a proprietary, hardware-agnostic software platform that serves as an intelligence layer designed to enable autonomous systems to operate, coordinate, and improve more effectively than they otherwise would in real-world physical environments. It is designed as a full-stack embodied AI software system that integrates multiple functional components intended to support autonomous operation and fleet-level coordination.

The two core features of Orchestrator are AI Optimization, Task Verification and Reporting. AI Optimization uses artificial intelligence to assess telemetry and run-time data and generate recommendations to improve performance against customer key performance indicators, across a customer’s fleet regardless of brand.
Task Verification and Reporting provides unified dashboarding and reporting across a customer’s full fleet and multiple robot types, including verification that assigned tasks have been completed.

MBody AI has cumulatively provided cleaning service for approximately 600 million square feet in the hospitality and building management industries, principally for Fortune 500 casino and resort operators. Each deployment is designed to generate proprietary operational data that refines the Company’s models and improves the performance of the platform over time.
“We are proud to be nominated for the AI Deployment of the year by Cloud Awards,”
said John Fowler, Chief Executive Officer of MBody AI.

“What put us on this shortlist is software running in production with Fortune 500 casino and resort operators, and operational data from those deployments that is designed to make the platform better over time. The recognition follows the work, not the other way around.”
Learn more about MBody AI’s growth trajectory at ir.mbody.ai

develops enterprise software that deploys and manages autonomous robot workforces for hospitality and gaming operators. The Company’s proprietary MBody AI Orchestrator is a hardware-agnostic software platform that manages diverse robot fleets from multiple vendors across sites and use cases under long-term agreements. MBody AI counts Fortune 500 operators among its customers.
